selection: Surveyed BRT forest/grass/heath/dune/sand covers >=40% of municipal part of source tile OR dunes >=0.5%; source bounds must contain valid elevations. Only native green/sand/footway/cycleway/road surfaces retained.
geometry: Original measured source heights; source-specific invalid terrain heights below -30 m omitted (exact missing sentinel and interpolated source ramps counted separately). Near-zero-plan-area vertical edge curtains also omitted; actual kade/muur and structural classes are not selected. Interior-only clustering 2 m horizontal / 0.25 m vertical; original boundary edges and face orientation checked, otherwise exact indexed source retained. Standard glTF quantization.
repairCountScope: All decoded source triangles in emitted tiles, before semantic and municipal selection; sentinel means within 5 cm of -99.99 m after coordinate decoding.
sourceRepair: Model-reviewed interpretation for this source, not a publisher-specified validity contract: 2D green/sand/path/road heights below -30 m are missing-height extrusion artifacts in the examined coast/port records. Near-zero-plan-area faces (minimum horizontal altitude <0.05 m and height range >1 m) are source edge curtains. Original cached bytes are unchanged; ordinary negative terrain is retained.
boundary: Only triangles whose three vertices are inside exact municipality retained; intersecting boundary triangles omitted, never stretched. Source water holes remain empty.
datesAndLimits: Upstream ground edition dates observed 2017–2019. Inventory HTTP Last-Modified is a file date, retained in sourceInventory, not a survey date. Individual BGT acquisition dates differ and are recorded per tile; not a current terrain survey. No photographic textures. Native source may contain errors or missing elevations.
